body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Syabas announced Popbox, a small, $129 open platform settop box that streams music, movies, photos, games, social media updates and more to today's HDTVs.

Popbox supports just about every audio and video file type and recognizes content from the Internet, a personal computer and a USB-attached storage device such as a Flip Video HD camcorder or an external hard drive.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
